_activity: Build the witness sentence: the railway, 1830
intro: Build the sentence. Choose the right piece for each blank. This is the witness starter your casefile uses.

tiles.text: In 1830, the Liverpool and Manchester Railway's own record
In 1761, the record of the Bridgewater Canal
raw materials for the textile mills came into Liverpool by ship and went on by rail
one horse could pull a canal boat carrying about 30 tons
Britain industrialized before any other country in Europe

correct_sentence: In 1830, the Liverpool and Manchester Railway's own record showed that raw materials for the textile mills came into Liverpool by ship and went on by rail (Doc 10).
hints: The first blank is your witness. A source with no author is still a witness: call it by what it is and when.
Two of the wrong tiles are true. They belong to Document 9, or to no document at all.
rationale: A witness sentence has three parts and loses credit if any one is missing: who and when, the evidence itself, and the number. 'Document 10' in the first blank is the weak opening - it names a page, not a witness. The 30 tons is Document 9's, and 'Britain industrialized first' is on neither page.
